We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first two templates successfully, got products. Need to continue applying remaining templates sequentially to generate precursors, building a tree.

Goal: final route JSON where root is target molecule (given SMILES). Then child reaction using template 29646, whose children are precursors (maybe multiple). Then each precursor may be further broken down using next template, etc. Must have at least 5 reactions (we have 5 templates). So each step we apply one template to each intermediate? Probably linear chain: each step takes one molecule and splits into precursors. So we need to apply template 29646 to target, get some precursors (maybe two). Then apply template 1914389 to each appropriate precursor (maybe one). Then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to find applicable matches. We have applied 29646 and got three possible products (list of tuples). The result from apply_template gave a tuple of three strings? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible precursor sets? Actually each tuple contains a single SMILES? It seems each result is a tuple of one SMILES. So three possible precursors (single). We need choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389. We already checked first one matches 1914389 (True). So we can use that as next step.

Thus step1: target -> via template 29646 -> precursor A = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"

Now apply template 1914389 to precursor A, got result: two precursors: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". So reaction splits into two products (two precursors). Good.

Now need to apply template 1914390 to each of those? Probably to one of them that matches. We tried checking both individually: first didn't match, second didn't match. So maybe need to apply 1914390 to a different precursor from earlier step (maybe other options from step1). Let's test other precursors from step1.

Check second precursor: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". Check with template 1914389? Already false. But we need template 1914390 now. Let's test both second and third from step1 with template 1914390.
